app.tenant_member.definition:
select "auth"."member"."user_id", "auth"."user"."name", "auth"."member"."role"
  from "auth"."member"
  inner join "auth"."user" on "auth"."user"."id" = "auth"."member"."user_id"
  where "auth"."member"."organization_id" = app.current_tenant_id()::text
app.tenant_member.name: tenant_member
